description: Construction of the Two Storied Building with a Lecture Hall and an Assembly Hall at the National College of Education, Peradeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-08-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon.Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education to award the construction of the above building to Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.
